name: FLA_PAYMENT_TEMPLATES_ALL_
description: FLA_PAYMENT_TEMPLATES_ALL contains payment term template information such as supplier information, payment purpose, and payment type, and so on. This defaults the data when this template is used on the lease payments.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TEMPLATE_ID
columns.description: Payment template identifier. This is primary key for the table.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: NAME
columns.description: Payment term name. It describes the payment term name.

columns.name: ORG_ID
columns.description: Indicates the identifier of the business unit associated to the row.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Payment type. Values are populated from lookup FND_LOOKUPS where lookup_type is FLA_PAYMENT_TYPE.

columns.name: PAYMENT_PURPOSE_CODE
columns.description: Payment purpose. Values are populated from lookup FND_LOOKUPS where lookup_type=FLA_PAYMENT_PURPOSE.

columns.name: ROU_ASSET_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether if we generate right of use stream for respective payment term or not.

columns.name: LIABILITY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether if we generate liability stream for respective payment term or not.

columns.name: ACTIVE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the template is in use or not.

columns.name: PAYMENT_FREQUENCY_CODE
columns.description: Payment frequency. Possible values are DAILY, MONTHLY, QUARTERLY, or ANNUALLY.

columns.name: DESCRIPTION
columns.description: Payment term template description.

columns.name: PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier. It is used to calculate due date for the payment term.

columns.name: VENDOR_ID
columns.description: Supplier identifier. It is referenced from POZ_SUPPLIERS table.

columns.name: VENDOR_SITE_ID
columns.description: Supplier site identifier. It is used to send the information to Payables during the payment process.

columns.name: DISTRIBUTION_SET_ID
columns.description: Distribution set identifier. It is passed into Payables.

columns.name: TAX_INCLUDED_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the tax is included or not.

columns.name: TAX_CLASSIFICATION_CODE
columns.description: Tax classification code for payment term.

columns.name: REPORT_FROM_INCEPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the streams generation is from the inception of the lease or not.

columns.name: INTERCOMPANY_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the payment term belongs to cross functional organization or not.

columns.name: PRIMARY_INTENDED_USE_CODE
columns.description: Tax Driver: The purpose for which a product may be used. The actual use will be stored at the distribution level.

columns.name: PRODUCT_CATEGORY
columns.description: Identifies the taxable nature of a noninventory based item for tax determination or tax reporting.

columns.name: PRODUCT_FISCAL_CLASSIFICATION
columns.description: Tax Driver: Product fiscal classification

columns.name: PRODUCT_TYPE
columns.description: Tax Driver: Type of product. Possible values are: Goods, Service. This value will default from Inventory Item attributes. Otherwise, value will be entered by user.

columns.name: TRX_BUSINESS_CATEGORY
columns.description: Tax Driver: Transactions category assigned by user.

columns.name: USER_DEFINED_FISCAL_CLASS
columns.description: Tax Driver: Fiscal Classification.

columns.name: WITHHOLDING_TAX_GROUP_ID
columns.description: Withholding tax group identifier

columns.name: OPTION_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates if this is a payment or an option.

columns.name: OPTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Option type code will have values like Renewal, Residual, Purchase etc.

columns.name: REVENUE_METHOD_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the method for spread of generated revenue, valid values are lease revenue and non lease revenue.

columns.name: SCHEDULE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Indicates the type of schedule, valid values are PAYMENT and BILLING.

columns.name: BILL_TO_CUSTOMER_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer identifier for the billing.

columns.name: BILL_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Bill to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: SHIP_TO_SITE_USE_ID
columns.description: Ship to customer site use identifier.

columns.name: CUSTOMER_TRX_TYPE_ID
columns.description: Transaction type identifier to be sent to Receivables.

columns.name: AR_PAYMENT_TERM_ID
columns.description: Payment term identifier sent to Receivables for calculation of due date.

columns.name: DOCUMENT_SUB_TYPE
columns.description: Classification used by a tax authority to categorize a document associated with a transaction for a tax.

columns.name: FIRST_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Deploying company's Tax Registration number

columns.name: THIRD_PTY_REG_ID
columns.description: Bill-to Customer Tax Registration Number

columns.name: AMORTIZE_EXEMPT_PAYMENT_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the exempt payment should be amortized over the term of the payment.

columns.name: GENERATE_INVOICE_FLAG
columns.description: Flag to indicate if the payment should be interfaced with Payables or Receivables during invoice creation.

columns.name: TAX_DETERMINANTS_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Source of the tax determinants when the payment is invoiced. Values can be Setup and Payment.

columns.name: APPLY_UPFRONT_TAX_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether upfront tax is applicable or not.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
